crop.notes: Whole 'The Ring' section; the Allen item is the first paragraph, followed by unrelated pugilistic notes. Its headline deck is at the top of the 'Crimson and Blue' column (article 876).

title.suggested: Charley Mitchell Writes Tom Allen from London

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Tom Allen received a letter from Charley Mitchell, dated London, Nov. 7, saying he was sure to fight Corbett and would surprise him within ten rounds, and discussing his pending assault appeal.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Saturday Evening, November 19, 1892, page 8.

facts.fact: Allen received a letter from Charley Mitchell in London about Mitchell's coming fight with Corbett and his assault appeal

notes: Quotes in the item are Mitchell's, not Allen's.
